claim_boundary: Deterministic timing variation for seven active standard machine-interrupt scenarios. It covers four assertion cycles per scenario, simultaneous-source priority, and entry-time CSR snapshots. Fast interrupts, nested handlers, asynchronous clock-domain behavior, formal proof, physical timing, and manufacturing signoff remain open.
